battle.name: 帕提亞入侵巴克特里亞
battle.theater: 巴克特里亞南部與安息邊境
battle.brief: 前167年前後，安息王彌陀里德一世趁巴克特里亞新主歐克拉提德斯與西邊塞琉古相持，從安息米底一線越境東進，並借大月氏騎兵之勢驅走歐克拉提德斯，一度盡取巴克特里亞。卡面希臘重步兵即巴克特里亞軍的希臘傭兵方陣，盾牆正面難破，卻追不上成群游騎的箭雨，只能靠嚴整陣形與投射武器支撐。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 前167年前後的帕提亞入侵巴克特里亞，交戰一方是安息（帕提亞）及其北方盟友大月氏（吐火羅）騎兵，另一方是希臘化巴克特里亞王國。帕提亞一方由帕提亞本部、米底、阿里亞等伊朗高原勢力拼成，國王彌陀里德一世號「萬王之王」，以盟誓與分封維繫的部族首領為附庸，兵員主體是能縱馬射箭的輕騎，輔以重裝騎兵、投槍手與大量持弓的部族戰士；此役大月氏提供成建制的騎兵大隊，兩軍合流後沿安息與巴克特里亞交界的河谷地帶東進。巴克特里亞一方是希臘化王國，國王歐克拉提德斯一世以希臘傭兵為方陣骨架，本地巴克特里亞人、波斯裔與索格底亞人提供徵召步兵與弓手，另有大月氏與塞種雇傭騎兵，國都在巴克特拉一帶，王宮、鑄幣廠與祭祀中心集中在河谷綠洲上。西邊的塞琉古王國被安條克四世的東征與宮廷內鬥牽制，無力介入；羅馬與埃及遠在萬里之外。這是一場兩強為中亞霸權與絲路北道控制權而打的邊境戰爭。
countriesEn: The Parthian invasion of Bactria of about 167 BC was fought between the Parthians (the Arsacid state of Parthia and Media) together with their northern allies, the Yuezhi or Tocharians, and the Hellenistic Greco-Bactrian kingdom. The Parthian side was an amalgam of Iranian highland powers: Parthia proper, Media and Aria, held together by the Arsacid house, whose king Mithridates I bore the title king of kings and ruled through tribal chiefs bound to him by oath and by gift. The bulk of his troops were light cavalry able to shoot from the saddle, supported by heavier horsemen, javelin-men and large numbers of tribal warriors armed with bows. For this campaign the Yuezhi supplied whole bodies of Tocharian cavalry, and the two armies moved east along the river valleys that marked the Parthian-Bactrian frontier. On the other side stood the Greco-Bactrian kingdom, whose king Eucratides I used Greek mercenaries as the skeleton of his phalanx, while local Bactrians, Persian-descended subjects and Sogdians supplied conscript infantry and archers, and further Tocharian and Saka mercenary horsemen rode on the wings. The capital sat in the Balkh region, with the royal residence, the mint and the cult centre grouped around the fertile oases of the valley. The Seleucid kingdom to the west was absorbed by Antiochus IV Epiphanes' eastern campaign and by palace intrigue and could not intervene; Rome and Egypt lay many thousands of kilometres away. This was therefore a frontier war between two powers contesting the hegemony of Central Asia and the control of the northern branch of the Silk Road.
people: 核心人物是安息王彌陀里德一世，即阿爾薩刻斯一世之子、前176年讓位於他的兄長弗拉泰斯一世之弟，前165年接掌王位。他是帕提亞編年史筆下最敢冒險的君主：正面強攻失利之後不逃回波斯本土，而是西行到大月氏營中求援。編年史記他見巴克特里亞王之敵意，心中恐懼，遂逃往大月氏王處求助；大月氏王給他一支龐大的月氏騎兵，他再整軍東進，逐走巴王。另一方是巴克特里亞王歐克拉提德斯一世。據查士丁尼《史前紀》，他是老王迪奧多托斯之子，被放逐之後受國人迎回，驅走塞種人，又召大月氏為援，並取下印度與大月氏之地；狄奧多洛斯《歷史圖書館》則記他率月氏軍東征印度時陣亡，把王國留給兒子埃利俄克勒斯。第三方人物是塞琉古王安條克四世，他前171至前164年的東征奪回巴比倫以東，一度插手巴克特里亞與索格底亞，把安息逼入低谷，也促成安息與大月氏的臨時結盟。出場的還有大月氏的首領，即漢代史籍所稱的月氏王；以及其後在帕提亞復國、終於前145年消滅希臘巴克特里亞王國的安息王米特里達二世。
peopleEn: The central figure is Mithridates I of Parthia, son of Arsaces I and younger brother of Phraates I, who had succeeded their father in 176 BC and then handed the throne to Mithridates, who took it in 165 BC. He is the most audacious ruler in the Parthian Chronicle: when his frontal offensive failed he did not retreat onto Iranian soil but rode west to the camp of the Yuezhi to ask for help. The chronicle states that, seeing the enmity of the king of Bactria and fearing it, he fled to the king of the Yue-chi and sought assistance; the Yuezhi king gave him a great force of Yuezhi cavalry, and he reorganized his army, marched east and drove out the Bactrian king. The other protagonist is Eucratides I of Bactria. Justin's Epitome describes him as a son of the old king Diodotus who had been exiled and was recalled by his subjects; he drove out the Saka, called in the Yuezhi as allies, and took India and the lands of the Yuezhi. Diodorus of Sicily, by contrast, has him killed while marching to India with Tocharian troops, leaving the kingdom to his son Heliocles. A third actor is the Seleucid king Antiochus IV Epiphanes, whose eastern campaign of 171-164 BC retook Babylonia and reached Bactria and Sogdia; he pushed the Parthians into a corner and simultaneously drove them into a temporary alliance with the Yuezhi. Present as well are the Yuezhi chieftains, the rulers whom the Han annals later call the kings of the Yuezhi, and at the end of the chain of events Mithridates II of Parthia, who restored the Arsacid house after Mithridates' death and in 145 BC destroyed the Greco-Bactrian kingdom.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘重步兵（hoplite），在巴克特里亞軍中的位置是步兵骨幹：圓盾（aspis）、青銅頭盔、胸甲或亞麻甲衣（linothorax）、約二公尺長的標槍（dory）與短劍（xiphos）。方陣的價值在於盾牆，前排重步兵彼此遮蔽，敵方弓矢大多被盾面擋下，敵軍必須先被推到方陣的鋼鐵邊緣才能傷人；希臘化時期的後繼兵種是持薩里沙長矛（sarissa）的密集方陣兵，並有持康托斯長矛（kontos）的伴騎協同。對面的安息一方是使用複合反弓的射手，配備刀劍兼用的短劍與長矛，稱為薩加特拉伊，弓程與射速都勝過希臘弓，攻城時另備攻城塔、撞槌、繃皮配筋的投石機（catapult）與配重式配弩；大月氏輕騎裝備從弓、箭到標槍，極少重甲，靠馬力與地形取得優勢。雙方關鍵的裝備落差是：方陣無法在對方射擊之後追擊與包抄，而安息與大月氏騎兵幾乎不需要與方陣正面碰撞。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Greek hoplite, and its place in the Bactrian army is that of the infantry backbone: the round shield (aspis), the bronze helmet, the breastplate or linen cuirass (linothorax), the thrusting spear of about two metres (dory) and the short sword (xiphos). The value of the phalanx lies in the shield wall: the front-rank hoplites cover one another, most enemy arrows strike the convex shields instead of flesh, and the enemy must first be brought up against the steel edge of the formation before it can do harm. The Hellenistic successor of this troop was the dense sarissa phalangite, armed with the long pike of roughly five and a half metres, working in concert with the kontos-bearing lancers of the accompanying cavalry. On the Parthian side the archers used a composite recurve bow and carried a short sword usable as a knife, the so-called sagittarius outfit, giving them greater range and rate of fire than a Greek bow; for sieges they brought up towers, battering rams, hide-and-sinew catapults and torsion engines, plus counterweighted bolt throwers. The lightly equipped Yuezhi horsemen carried bow, arrow and javelin and almost no heavy armour, winning their advantage through horse and terrain. The decisive difference in equipment is this: a phalanx cannot pursue and envelop after it has been shot at, while Parthian and Tocharian cavalry hardly ever have to collide with it face to face.
tactics: 帕提亞與大月氏的戰術核心是不接戰：騎兵列隊在方陣長矛觸及之外的距離，輪番齊射，後世稱之為安息之箭，把箭幕壓在方陣頭頂，逼希臘方陣收緊而士氣受挫，再以密集的楔形騎隊衝擊方陣側面或陣形出現缺口的部位，插入之後分割敵列。塞琉古將軍歐墨尼亞斯在加比尼戰役（前321年）對安息射手法比萊斯的記錄正是此理的最好說明：方陣在箭雨之下推進，卻始終觸不到放箭的人。另一個常見套路是進退佯動，假裝撤退引誘追擊的步兵脫離方陣，再回身射擊專打落單者。巴克特里亞方的應對是維持緊密方陣、拒絕追擊、以斜陣（refused flank）與空心方陣封住側翼缺口，用投射武器（弩砲、石彈投擲機）與長矛打擊接近的騎兵，撤退時以車陣（saka sagmara）與輜重車組成環形壁壘，這一招安條克一世在前217年的安息戰役已用過。補給方面，安息騎兵自備乾糧、靠徵發與掠奪過境，攻城器械不常隨軍；巴克特里亞方則依賴巴克特拉等據點的城市補給與城外莊園的糧源。
tacticsEn: The core of Parthian and Tocharian tactics was not to engage: the horsemen formed up beyond the reach of the phalanx spears and fired in relays, what later writers call the Parthian shot, pressing a curtain of arrows over the heads of the phalanx, forcing the Greek formation to close up while its morale sagged, and then sending dense wedge-shaped squadrons into the flank of the phalanx or into the gaps opened in it, cutting the enemy ranks apart from within. The clearest demonstration of the principle is the account of the Parthian archers of Spadis at the battle of Gabiene in 321 BC written by the Seleucid general Eumenes: the phalanx advanced under a rain of arrows and never once reached the men who were shooting at it. The other standard trick was the feigned retreat, luring infantry out of formation and then turning to shoot down the men who had broken ranks. The Bactrian answer was to keep the phalanx closed, refuse to pursue, plug the flanks with a refused line and hollow squares, meet the approaching horsemen with missile weapons such as bolt-shooters and stone-throwers and long spears, and to form a ring of wagons and baggage carts as a laager when falling back, a measure Antiochus I had already used against the Parthians in 217 BC. In logistics the Parthian horsemen carried their own rations and lived off requisition and plunder, and siege engines seldom travelled with them; the Bactrians drew supplies from the cities of places such as Balkh and from the estates of the oasis.
data: 可核對的數字有限：戰役年份一般定在前167年前後，維基百科所收的說法把彌陀里德一世進入歐克拉提德斯領土的時間放在前163至前155年之間，前141年他才奪取美索不達米亞，安息國勢自此成形。歐克拉提德斯的在位期一般記為前171至前145年，他死後兒子埃利俄克勒斯繼位，希臘巴克特里亞王國在其後為帕提亞所滅。地理尺度上，巴克特里亞王國的疆域由阿姆河（古稱奧克蘇斯）東岸延伸到印度河上游，北接索格底亞與大月氏的吐火羅地區，南抵安息與阿里亞；巴克特拉（今巴克夫，Balkh）位於北緯36.7度、東經66.9度，是王國最重要的城與商路樞紐。大月氏西遷的時間多定在前170至前160年代，背景是匈奴西進。武器尺度方面，重步兵的圓盾直徑約六十至九十公分，標槍長約二公尺；安息弓的有效射程遠在方陣長矛之外，一般以數十步至百步計，騎兵齊射一輪可覆蓋數百步寬的正面。雙方確切兵員、陣亡與俘虜數目在《帕提亞編年史》、狄奧多洛斯與查士丁尼的殘篇中都沒有留下可信記載，本條只按上述可查的年份、里程與尺寸登錄，並未杜撰戰損數字。史料亦不載本役的確切月份，戰役檔按前167年首月登錄。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few. The campaign is usually dated to about 167 BC, while the dating collected by Wikipedia places Mithridates I's entry into Eucratides' territory between 163 and 155 BC; Mithridates took Babylonia only in 141 BC, and the Parthian state took its shape from that point onward. Eucratides' reign is usually given as 171-145 BC; after his death his son Heliocles succeeded him, and the Greco-Bactrian kingdom was then destroyed by the Parthians. In geographical terms the kingdom of Bactria ran from the eastern bank of the Oxus, the ancient name of the Amu Darya, to the upper Indus, with Sogdia and the Tocharian lands of the Yuezhi to the north and Parthia and Aria to the south. Bactra, modern Balkh, lies at about 36.7 degrees north and 66.9 degrees east and was the kingdom's most important city and caravan hub. The westward migration of the Yuezhi is generally placed in the 170s to 160s BC, against the background of the Xiongnu advance. As for weapon dimensions, the round shield of a hoplite measured roughly sixty to ninety centimetres across and the thrusting spear was about two metres long; the effective range of a Parthian bow lay well beyond the reach of phalanx spears, commonly counted in tens of paces up to a hundred, and a single relay of mounted archers could cover a front several hundred paces wide. No reliable figures for the numbers of troops engaged, of casualties or of prisoners survive in the Parthian Chronicle or in the fragments of Diodorus and Justin; this entry therefore records only the datable years, the distances and the dimensions, and invents no casualty figures. The sources likewise give no month for the campaign, so the battle file is registered under the first month of 167 BC.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一，歐克拉提德斯在巴克特里亞奪權之後立刻西征帕提亞與索格底亞，把迪奧多托斯二世時期丟給安息的南方領土重新奪回，帕提亞腹背受敵。第二，塞琉古王安條克四世自前171年起東征，兵鋒直指巴克特里亞與索格底亞，安息王庭擔心兩面受敵，只好冒險行動，試圖先取南方；狄奧多洛斯提到安條克四世在索格底亞與巴克特里亞扶植自己的守將，這一時期巴克特里亞與安息都曾在塞琉古的棋盤上被拉攏或推開。第三，遊牧勢力的南移改變了整個棋盤：匈奴西進把大月氏從河西走廊逐向中亞，大月氏湧入吐火羅與巴克特里亞，使原本希臘化的城邦小國捲入混戰，也給了安息王用遊牧騎兵收復失地的選項，這正是編年史記載的安息向大月氏求援、由月氏騎兵開道的那一步。內因是安息本身的制度：阿爾薩刻斯王朝靠部族聯盟起家，國王的權力建立在幾支部族的效忠上，國王一旦在戰場上失利就可能失去整個部族的支持，因此求援與冒險不是例外，而是體制的常態。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. First, once Eucratides had seized the throne of Bactria he turned west at once against Parthia and Sogdia, taking back the southern territories that had been lost under Diodotus II, and Parthia was caught between fronts. Second, the Seleucid king Antiochus IV Epiphanes had marched east from 171 BC with his spearhead directed at Bactria and Sogdia; the Parthian court, fearing to be squeezed from two sides, took the risk and moved first for the south. Diodorus records that Antiochus IV planted his own governors in Sogdia and Bactria, and during this period Bactria and Parthia were alternately courted and pushed aside in the Seleucid game. Third, the southward movement of the nomads reshaped the whole board. The Xiongnu advance pushed the Yuezhi out of the Hexi corridor and into Central Asia; the Yuezhi poured into Transoxiana and Bactria, dragging the small Hellenistic city-states into the turmoil and giving the Parthian king the option of recovering his losses with nomadic cavalry. That is precisely the step the chronicle records, the Parthians seeking help from the Yuezhi and the moon-chi cavalry opening the road. The internal cause lies in the constitution of Parthia itself: the Arsacid house had risen as a tribal confederation, and the king's authority rested on the loyalty of a few clans, so a king who lost a battle risked losing an entire clan. Seeking help and gambling were therefore not exceptions in this system but its normal practice.
impact: 這場戰爭是安息從邊境小國變成中亞強權的轉折點，也是希臘化世界與遊牧世界在巴克特里亞的第一次正面碰撞。對安息而言，雖然彌陀里德一世此役先勝後敗、陣亡於歐克拉提德斯之手，安息卻由此佔有巴克特里亞南部的阿里亞、馬爾吉亞那與西部巴克特里亞，王庭重心西移到米底與埃克巴塔那，前141年奪取美索不達米亞之後，帕提亞成為西亞與中亞之間唯一的強權，安息和平一直維持到前141年羅馬的干預。對巴克特里亞而言，希臘化王國保住核心但損失南方，被迫把國策轉向東方與印度，其貨幣、希臘語與城市生活方式仍延續下來，直到前145年被帕提亞最終兼併。對大月氏而言，他們佔有阿姆河以南的吐火羅，後來南下巴比倫與旁遮普，於前一世紀中葉建立漢朝稱為大夏的貴霜帝國，並與漢朝屢次通使；張騞於前126年抵達大夏時聽到的故事，正源於這次西遷所開的中亞通道。對武器史而言，希臘方陣與草原騎射的第一次大規模對撞，確立了遠程騎射壓制重步兵的長期格局，安息弓法後來在歐、亞、非的戰場上被反覆模仿與破解。
impactEn: This war was the turning point that turned Parthia from a small frontier state into a Central Asian power, and it was the first direct collision between the Hellenistic world and the nomadic world in Bactria. For Parthia, although Mithridates I won the campaign and then lost his life at Eucratides' hands, the war left the Arsacids holding Aria, Margiana and western Bactria in the south, and the centre of the court shifted west towards Media and Ecbatana; after the seizure of Babylonia in 141 BC Parthia was the only great power between the Near East and Central Asia, and the Parthian peace held until Roman intervention. For Bactria, the Hellenistic kingdom kept its core but lost its southern provinces and was forced to turn its policy eastwards towards India; its coinage, its Greek language and its urban way of life continued until the kingdom was finally absorbed by Parthia in 145 BC. For the Yuezhi, they held Transoxiana south of the Oxus, moved later into Babylonia and Punjab, and founded in the middle of the first century BC the Kushan empire that the Han called Daxia, with repeated embassies to the Han court; the stories Zhang Qian heard when he reached Daxia in 126 BC trace straight back to the corridor opened by this migration. For the history of weapons, the first great collision between the Greek phalanx and steppe horse-archery settled the long-term pattern in which mounted missile fire overmatched heavy infantry, and the Parthian shot was afterwards imitated and countered again and again on battlefields in Europe, Asia and Africa.
result: 戰役的直接結果是帕提亞與大月氏的聯軍攻入巴克特里亞，歐克拉提德斯被迫放棄王國東走印度與大月氏故地，安息一度取得巴克特里亞的統治，名義上並把歐克拉提德斯置於附庸地位，查士丁尼與斯特拉保都作此記載。但這只是中段：不久之後歐克拉提德斯藉大月氏與塞種雇傭兵回師，與安息軍再戰，據編年史與查士丁尼，他陣前殺死彌陀里德一世，安息王國幾乎覆亡，其兄弟與部族首領才在內部分裂中把王位重新扶起，米特里達二世接位。帕提亞與巴克特里亞的爭奪又拖了近二十年，前145年埃利俄克勒斯在戰役中敗於安息，希臘巴克特里亞王國正式滅亡，其西部被大月氏吸收，其南部併入安息，東部的印度則先後落入大月氏與塞種建立的貴霜與印度舍人王朝。從更大範圍看，帕提亞的勝利把中亞北道與東西商路的一段納入安息體系，也把希臘化巴克特里亞的居民與工匠分散到伊朗與印度，間接催生了後來中亞與南亞的一段混合文化。戰役結束時，帕提亞仍是一個以伊朗高原為核心的騎兵國家，而它的對手已不再是可與之抗衡的希臘王國。
resultEn: The immediate result of the campaign was that the allied Parthian and Yuezhi armies entered Bactria, Eucratides was forced to abandon the kingdom and march east towards India and the lands of the Yuezhi, and Parthia for a while took control of Bactria, nominally holding Eucratides as a vassal, a state of affairs recorded by both Justin and Strabo. But that was only the middle of the story. Not long afterwards Eucratides returned with Yuezhi and Saka mercenaries, fought the Parthian army again, and, according to the chronicle and Justin, killed Mithridates I in the course of the battle; the Parthian kingdom was brought to the verge of destruction, and only the king's brothers and the tribal chiefs were able to re-establish a ruler amid the internal split, with Mithridates II taking the throne. The Parthian-Bactrian contest dragged on for nearly two more decades: in 145 BC Heliocles was defeated by the Parthians in battle and the Greco-Bactrian kingdom was formally extinguished, its western lands absorbed by the Yuezhi, its southern lands incorporated into Parthia, while India in the east passed in turn to the empires of the Yuezhi and the Sakas, the Kushan and the Indo-Scythian. On a wider view, the Parthian victory drew the northern branch of the Central Asian routes and a section of the east-west caravan road into the Parthian system, and scattered the population and craftsmen of Hellenistic Bactria across Iran and India, indirectly fostering the mixed culture of Central and South Asia that followed. By the end of the campaign Parthia was still a cavalry state centred on the Iranian highlands, but the opponent it faced was no longer a Hellenistic kingdom able to match it.
